scope: Research pilots, followed by benchmarked capability development; no general shape inventor or manufacturing release

work_packages.title: Mandatory process profiles
work_packages.implemented: Profiles for all physical task families; represented-part process allocation, rectangular nesting and assembly/removal replay for the new demonstrations
work_packages.exit_evidence: Geometry-bound process records, negative controls and actual workshop/inspection evidence

work_packages.title: Broader live adapters
implemented: Ten civil deck families with pier/material/foundation choices
work_packages.registration: Exact-source independent/adverse benchmark receipt and review required before queue admission

work_packages.title: Shape and assembly architecture
implemented: Variable crown and bounded civil section dimensions
work_packages.exit_evidence: Reconstruct manufactured CAD, apply process constraints and independently verify that exact geometry

work_packages.title: Material and laminate architecture
work_packages.implemented: Three explicit face layups, thickness and inseparable public core-grade bundles; independent laminate A/B/D comparison
remaining: Local reinforcement, ply drops and inserts
Measured ageing, fire, fatigue and damage data
work_packages.blocked_finding: Current registered foam grades fail the fixed 85C roof context; no threshold relaxation or synthetic supplier substitution

work_packages.title: Multiphysics
implemented: Two-zone heat/moisture with door and ventilation hypotheses
Duct pressure loss and fan power
Battery cooling-loss duty and auxiliary capacity
remaining: OpenFOAM or qualified Modelica ventilation/refrigeration adapter
work_packages.exit_evidence: Independent/adverse benchmarks, supplier maps, conservation and mesh/time refinement, then SIL/HIL or physical tests

work_packages.title: Manufacturing objectives
remaining: Contour nesting and actual production-unit grouping
Quoted costs and calibrated labour/inspection effort
work_packages.rule: Unknown time and cost remain null; part count or operation count is not a labour quote

workflow: Select fixed function and material/process bundle
Regenerate physical inventory, mass and physics
Confirm selected exact revisions in native CAD and scoped independent numerics
Veto failures and hold unavailable evidence
Nominate a new bounded capability only after separate benchmarks and exact-source review

primary_workflow_references.use: Process-dependent search constraints; no proprietary implementation dependency
Future topology adapter; not installed or registered by this change
Future system/control and multizone reference integration
